checks: Two independent calculations (deriver: hand + own index script; checker: toolkit uv_pole + explicit-matrix script + exact group fit) agree on every per-topology coefficient and every gauge-factor combination.

Referee re-evaluation with own scripts (referee_check_bosonic.py, referee_check_fermion.py): per-word (x,y) of all eight topologies reproduced exactly; fermion box with explicit Dirac matrices: (-2/3, 4/3) for P_L and P_R, no epsilon structure.
Each species sums to commutator form (x = -y/2): B and mixed functions vanish; physical pole is kappa^(r) times the invariant quartic YM term.

Slavnov-Taylor: delta z_4 = 2 delta z_1 - delta z_A with the actual results of g0_VV (delta z_A = 5/3 C_ad - 1/3 S_H - 2/3 S_F) and g0_VVV (delta z_1 = 2/3 C_ad - 1/3 S_H - 2/3 S_F): G -7/3 g_s^2, W -13/6 g^2.
Textbook QCD Z_4 at xi = 1: Z_4 - 1 = -(g_s^2/16 pi^2 eps)(C_A/3 + 4/3 T_F n_f) with n_f = 2 Dirac: 7/3 g_s^2.

Literature (targets 2.1, BIMS 2004.14398 at xi = 1): Gamma_div contains 1/3 C_ad S_AAAA (d-dim) - 1/12 Tr_H(FF) (d-dim) - 1/6 sum_f Tr_f(Fbar Fbar): quartic parts agree exactly, including barred vs d-dimensional.
Diagram counts agree with ENUMERATION.md (GGGG 42, WWWW 517 component diagrams; multiplet-level topologies per assignment).
M independence, m^2 drops out (omega = 0), N_1 = 0.
